entries.headline: IDF and ISA Hamas-member announcement highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a joint IDF and ISA announcement saying their forces eliminated a Hamas member alleged to have taken part in an abduction, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: French military-deployment report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report citing Reuters and the French interior minister about a planned French military deployment, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Black Sea military air activity elevated
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States and military air activity near the Black Sea at almost six times normal levels.

entries.headline: AP Afghanistan coalition casualty figures highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Associated Press figure that more than 1,100 non-U.S. service personnel died in the Afghanistan conflict, including 457 from the United Kingdom. The item was credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Downing Street criticism of Pete Hegseth highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Guardian report that Downing Street criticised Pete Hegseth for downplaying NATO allies’ role in helping the United States with combat operations. The item was credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: UK MoD Typhoon statement highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report quoting the UK Ministry of Defence on Royal Air Force Typhoon fighter-jet participation, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: UK support for Saudi Arabia against Houthis highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Associated Press report that Britain was expanding military support for Saudi Arabia against the Houthis, including a defensive air component, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Eastern Mediterranean and Baltic air activity elevated
entries.summary: War Watch reported air activity in the Eastern Mediterranean and Baltic regions at nearly three times normal levels, with multiple U.S. transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the North Atlantic and continental United States.

entries.headline: RC-135W Rivet Joint sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing RC-135W Rivet Joint aircraft with hex code 43C38C. The sighting was credited to truthseekr60 and the photo to Alon Varshaver via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: USAF cargo and surveillance activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force cargo and surveillance aircraft airborne, including spy planes over the Baltic and a radar aircraft over the North Sea.

entries.headline: ASTRA Tambov pumping-station fire report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an ASTRA report that the Nikolskoye pumping station in Russia’s Tambov region was on fire, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Suspilne Dnipro warehouse-attack report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that three people were wounded in a Russian attack on warehouses in the suburbs of Dnipro, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.

entries.headline: Falcon 50 overrun and Las Vegas runway closures reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Falcon 50 N200SG rejected takeoff on runway 01L at Harry Reid International Airport, overran and struck the perimeter fence, with no injuries. It said runways 01L and 01R later reopened after inspection.

entries.headline: B737 airborne alert at Virginia Beach
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a B737 aircraft at Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States. The callsign was shown as CNV4989.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an E-6 aircraft at Suisun, California, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Ballina
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Ballina, Ireland. The callsign was shown as PK191.

entries.headline: Tu-160M modernization report highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that Russia revamped the Tu-160M Blackjack bomber with modular electronics.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Kalghatgi
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Kalghatgi, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Kalghatgi
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Kalghatgi, India. The callsign was shown as NA.
